test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: With which dance form is the noted dancer Pratibha Prahlad associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharata Natyam.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prathibha Prahlad is a ****Bharata Natyam** dancer, educator, choreographer, arts administrator, and author.
 
• She was the originator director of the** Delhi International Arts Festival.**
 
• Bharatanatyam is **the oldest classical dance tradition in India**. 
 
• Bharatanatyam is the state dance form of **Tamil Nadu.**
 
• Bharatanatyam is famous for its** grace, purity, tenderness, and sculpturesque poses.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Kathakali is **a major form of classical Indian dance**.
 
• Kathak is a member of eight major forms of **Indian Classical Dance.****​ **
 
• **Odissi **is a dance form from the state of Odisha in **eastern India.**
